dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We'll begin now that it's time.

dialogue.content: はい。承知しました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 15歳　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 15 years old and female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 校則がウザくてたまらないです
dialogue.English: I can’t stand the school rules; they’re so annoying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、例えば、どんな校則ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, which rules are bothering you?

dialogue.content: 髪の毛は黒くないとだめってことです
dialogue.English: The one that says our hair has to be black.

dialogue.content: なるほど、真っ黒でないとダメということなんですね
dialogue.English: I see—so it has to be jet black.

dialogue.content: 元々地毛が茶色いのに、黒く染めろっていうんですよ！
dialogue.English: My natural hair color is brown, but they're telling me to dye it black!

dialogue.content: 変だと思いませんか？
dialogue.English: Don’t you think that’s strange?

dialogue.content: 生まれつきの色がそれぞれあるのに、それは認めてもらえないなんて
dialogue.English: Everyone has their own natural hair color, but it sounds like they won't accept that.

dialogue.content: 納得いかないですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to accept, isn't it?

dialogue.content: しかもそれって、お金だってかかるでしょ
dialogue.English: And besides, it costs money, right?

dialogue.content: 先生が染めろというのですか？
dialogue.English: Is it a teacher who's telling you to dye it?

dialogue.content: ばかみたい
dialogue.English: It’s ridiculous.

dialogue.content: はい、生活指導の先生がうるさいんです
dialogue.English: Yes, the discipline teacher keeps nagging me about it.

dialogue.content: ホントですね、馬鹿にしてます
dialogue.English: It really is. It sounds dismissive.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: It is, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 因みに、何と呼んで良いですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what should I call you?

dialogue.content: のん　です
dialogue.English: You can call me Non.

dialogue.content: のんさん、その時先生には何か伝えたのですか？
dialogue.English: Non, did you say anything to the teacher then?

dialogue.content: 染めていて茶色いんじゃないって言いました
dialogue.English: I said it’s not brown because it's dyed; it’s my natural color.

dialogue.content: 先生は何と？
dialogue.English: What did the teacher say?

dialogue.content: 黒が決まりだからって。
dialogue.English: They just said, "Black is the rule."

dialogue.content: それは理不尽に感じますよね
dialogue.English: That must feel so unfair.

dialogue.content: はい。だからって、わざわざくろくするなんで、馬鹿げてると思います
dialogue.English: Yes. I think it's absurd to have to go out of my way to dye it black just because of that.

dialogue.content: 茶色く染めるのと色が違うだけで
dialogue.English: It's just a different color from dyeing it brown,

dialogue.content: 黒く染めるのも、同じ行為ですよね
dialogue.English: and dyeing it black is the same act, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。でも言っても聞いてくれないんです
dialogue.English: Exactly. But no matter what I say, they won’t listen.

dialogue.content: 入学した時からなんですか？
dialogue.English: Has it been this way since you started school?

dialogue.content: はい、毎月検査があります
dialogue.English: Yes, there’s an inspection every month.

dialogue.content: 生まれつきなのを言っても聞いてもらえないなんて、悲しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: It’s disheartening that they won’t listen even when you explain it’s natural.

dialogue.content: はい、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. What should I do?

dialogue.content: 先生に言って聞き入れたもらえないとき、のんさんは今までどうしてました？
dialogue.English: When the teachers wouldn't listen, what have you done until now, Non?

dialogue.content: 時間が過ぎるのをやり過ごしてました
dialogue.English: I just tried to ride it out and wait for time to pass.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、すぎるのを待つしかなくなりますよね。毎月の検査はどうされているんですか？
dialogue.English: Right—you end up having no choice but to wait it out. How do you handle the monthly inspections?

dialogue.content: また時間が過ぎるのをこらえているしかない感じです
dialogue.English: Again, it feels like all I can do is grit my teeth and endure until it's over.

dialogue.content: 実際に染めることは？
dialogue.English: Have you actually dyed it?

dialogue.content: 納得いかないし、染めたくありません
dialogue.English: I don’t agree with it, and I don’t want to dye it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、納得いかないと思います。
dialogue.English: That's understandable; it's hard to accept.

dialogue.content: それでも先生は、毎月染めろというのですね？
dialogue.English: And even so, the teacher keeps telling you every month to dye it?

dialogue.content: はい。内申書にも響くかもしれないって聞くんですけど、染める気になれません
dialogue.English: Yes. I've heard it might affect my school report, but I just can't bring myself to dye it.

dialogue.content: 来週また検査があるんですけど、
dialogue.English: There’s another inspection next week, and...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、そんな気にはなれないですよね
dialogue.English: I can see why you wouldn't feel like doing that.

dialogue.content: はい、検査ですね
dialogue.English: Yes, the inspection.

dialogue.content: 自分は間違っていないと思うんですけど、どうしたらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I don’t think I’m in the wrong, but what should I do?

dialogue.content: このことを、誰かに相談したことはあります？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: 先輩に言っても、ずっと前からの規則だし、
dialogue.English: I told an upperclassman, but they just said it’s been the rule for ages, and...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: でも、今の生活指導の先生になってからは特に厳しくなったって言ってました
dialogue.English: But they said it’s gotten especially strict since the current discipline teacher took over.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご両親は、このこと知ってますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do your parents know about this?

dialogue.content: 言えません
dialogue.English: I can’t tell them.

dialogue.content: 言えないんですね。それは、何か言われと思って？
dialogue.English: You feel like you can’t tell them. Is it because you're worried about what they might say?

dialogue.content: うち、お母さん居ないんですけど、こんなこと、お父さんに言うのはどうかと思います
dialogue.English: I don’t have a mother, and I’m not sure it’s something I should bring up with my father.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: おとうさんからは、もし伝えたら何て言われると思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think your father would say if you told him?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don’t know.

dialogue.content: 想像がつかないのですね。
dialogue.English: It’s hard to even imagine, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: No...

dialogue.content: 誰にも聞き入れてもらえないなんて、何も悪いことしていないのに何だかもやもやしますね。
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating that nobody will listen, especially when you haven't done anything wrong.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を、まとめさせてくださいね
dialogue.English: Let me summarize what we've talked about so far.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: のんさんは、生まれつき茶色の髪を、校則で黒く染めろと先生から言われて、のんさんの染めたくない思いを、受け入れてもらえない。先輩に相談しても、規則だからと言われて、気持ちを分かってもらえない。お父さんには、何ていわれるかわからなくて、相談しずらい。
dialogue.English: So, Non, your hair is naturally brown, but your teachers are telling you to dye it black because of a school rule, and they won't accept your wish not to dye it. When you talked to an upperclassman, they just said it's the rule and didn't seem to understand how you feel. And you find it hard to talk to your father because you don't know what he would say.

dialogue.content: このように感じたのですが、いかがです？
dialogue.English: Is that a fair summary of how you feel?

dialogue.content: はい。やっぱりおかしいと思うんです。
dialogue.English: Yes. I still think it’s wrong.

dialogue.content: おかしいと思いますよね
dialogue.English: It does seem wrong, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 生活指導の先生は
dialogue.English: The discipline teacher—

dialogue.content: 担任の先生？
dialogue.English: is that your homeroom teacher?

dialogue.content: いいえ、違います
dialogue.English: No, they’re not.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生に相談したことはあるのかな？
dialogue.English: Have you tried talking to your homeroom teacher?

dialogue.content: 担任の先生も他の先生もみんな全体的に、そんな考えです。だから、話しても無駄です
dialogue.English: My homeroom teacher and all the other teachers pretty much think the same way. So, it's pointless to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どの先生もそんな考えなんて、わかってもらえなくて、悲しいよね
dialogue.English: It's sad that none of the teachers seem to understand.

dialogue.content: 何とかわかってもらいたいよね
dialogue.English: You just want them to understand somehow, don't you?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと話も聞いてほしいよね
dialogue.English: You want them to really listen to what you have to say, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい。検査もあるし、嫌になってしまいます
dialogue.English: Yes. With the inspections, too, I’m just getting fed up with it all.

dialogue.content: だって、生まれつきののんさんの体の一部なんだから
dialogue.English: Because it's a natural part of your body, Non.

dialogue.content: 生まれつきのものを直せと言われたら、すごく悲しいよね
dialogue.English: It must be very hurtful to be told to "fix" something you were born with.

dialogue.content: のんさん、どうなったら一番嬉しいと思う？
dialogue.English: Non, what would make you happiest?

dialogue.content: これって、人権侵害ですよね
dialogue.English: This is a human rights violation, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: そうそう
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 先生たち、気が付かないのかなあ？
dialogue.English: I wonder if the teachers realize that.

dialogue.content: 教育委員会に言ってもらえませんか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell the Board of Education for me?

dialogue.content: 教育委員会に伝われば、どうなっていくと思う？
dialogue.English: If this were communicated to the Board of Education, what do you think would happen?

dialogue.content: それは、のんさんが一番嬉しい？
dialogue.English: Would that outcome make you happiest?

dialogue.content: やっぱり、内申書に響くってことですか？
dialogue.English: Does this mean it will still affect my school record after all?

dialogue.content: 内申書については、分からないけど
dialogue.English: I’m not sure about your school report, but...

dialogue.content: のんさんは、教育委員会に伝えたい？
dialogue.English: do you want to tell the Board of Education?

dialogue.content: 相談員さんから伝えてもらえるんですよね・・・
dialogue.English: You can tell them for me, right...?

dialogue.content: のんさんの近くで、そういう人はいそう？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone around you who could do that?

dialogue.content: 伝えてくれる人のことですか？
dialogue.English: You mean someone who would tell them for me?

dialogue.content: そうですね、教育委員会でも先生でも、こんなのんさんのモヤモヤした気持ち
dialogue.English: Yes, someone—whether at the board of education or a teacher—who could hear about these frustrating feelings you have,

dialogue.content: 聞いてくれたり、分かってくれる人
dialogue.English: someone who would listen and understand.

dialogue.content: 友達同士では変だって話してるけど、
dialogue.English: My friends and I talk about how strange it is, but...

dialogue.content: 来週の検査が来るから、どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.English: the inspection is next week, so I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: 友達同士では、おかしいってみんな思っているんだね
dialogue.English: So all your friends think it's wrong, too.

dialogue.content: でも、実際に染めなくちゃならないって言われてるのはクラスでは自分だけです
dialogue.English: But I’m the only one in my class who’s actually being told I have to dye it.

dialogue.content: 例えば、お友達のお父さん、お母さんでそんな関わりのある方もどこかにいるかもしれません、
dialogue.English: For example, maybe one of your friends’ parents has some kind of connection that could help,

dialogue.content: それに小さいころからの写真とか、本当に生まれつきだという証明があったりしたら
dialogue.English: Also, what if you had proof that it's your natural hair color, like photos from when you were little?

dialogue.content: どうでしょう？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい、写真探してみます
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll look for some photos.

dialogue.content: 生まれつきの、のんさんの大事な体ですので、ずっと大切に思う、のんさんの気持ち
dialogue.English: It's a natural and precious part of your body, so your desire to cherish it

dialogue.content: とても伝わってきましたよ。親孝行なのんさん、堂々と胸を張って良いと思います
dialogue.English: ...has come through very clearly. You are a thoughtful person, Non, and I think you can hold your head high.

dialogue.content: 先生もわかってもらえると良いですね！
dialogue.English: I hope your teachers will come to understand, too!

dialogue.content: 他に、何か話したいことはありませんか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you’d like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I’m okay for now. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: また何かありましたら、いつでも遠慮なく来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: はい。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: それでは、終了させていただきますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then we'll conclude our session for today. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。お疲れさまでした。｝
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. This was a good learning experience. Great work.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れさまでした。こちらこそ、良い勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Great work. It was a good learning experience for me as well.)
